main.about:
A curious guy who really gets into it once he gets a grasp of whatever he's doing
Hi, I'm Manu. Programming technician who really likes python and would rather avoid java like the plague. Jokes aside though, I like coding in projects of any size and especially seeing the results: a nice, working and efficient program that does what it's supposed to do. I am a bit shy tho, you have to get me out of my shell most of the time, but once I've warmed up to everybody things usually go smoothly. My favourite pastimes are listening to music (mostly game OSTs, EDM and nu metal), playing and modding games (mostly PAYDAY 2 and Source games), reading manga or sometimes rewatching old movies that I'd religiously watch as a kid.
